#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    
    vector<int> evenCount(n), oddCount(n);
    evenCount[0] = (arr[0] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    oddCount[0] = (arr[0] % 2 == 0) ? 0 : 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i-1] + (arr[i] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0);
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i-1] + (arr[i] % 2 == 0 ? 0 : 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> gaps;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (evenCount[i-1] == oddCount[i-1]) {
            gaps.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]));
        }
    }
    
    sort(gaps.begin(), gaps.end());
    
    int count = 0;
    for (int g : gaps) {
        if (g <= k) {
            ++count;
            k -= g;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    cout << count << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
